name: Reject Flare with genuinely depleted Magicka

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local timer=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 timer=timer+dt;if timer<0.2 then return end;timer=0
 assert(self.cell.isExterior,'Expected genuine outdoor sewer exit')
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died at Flare preflight')
 print('VilverinFlareReady cell='..self.cell.name..' position='..tostring(self.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' magicka='..Actor.stats.dynamic.magicka(self).current)
end}}}}
